//: Both halves of the portal deploy here: the React application as static
files, and the Express API as a serverless function under api/.
Because they share an origin, the API needs no CORS entry and the session
cookie stays SameSite=lax — neither VITE_API_URL nor COOKIE_SAMESITE is
wanted in this arrangement. They exist for hosting the two apart.
This repository is an npm workspace, so the build runs the web workspace
and writes web/dist rather than the `public` Vercel looks for by default.
The API requires DATABASE_URL — there is no disk here for a local database
— and S3_BUCKET, since uploaded files would otherwise be written to a

rewrites.//: Everything the API owns goes to the function, with its path intact.
Stored files are served by the API, which reads them from object storage.
The portal resolves its own routes: /admin/students is not a file on disk, so anything that is not a real file returns index.html.
